title: ParaLin++: Accelerating Parallel Diffusion Integrator via Intrinsic Partially Linear Structure
title_zh: ParaLin++：利用内在部分线性结构加速并行扩散积分器

paragraphs.en: Training-free few-step samplers are often described as nearly quality-lossless under conventional FID/CLIP-style evaluation. It remains unclear whether that conclusion transfers to more realistic and complex generation-quality benchmarks. We first systematize the quality metrics used to evaluate training-free sampling acceleration for diffusion and flow-matching models.
paragraphs.zh: 免训练少步采样器在传统的 FID/CLIP 式评估下常被描述为几乎无损画质。 这一结论是否适用于更真实、更复杂的生成质量基准，仍不清楚。 我们首先系统梳理了用于评估扩散模型与流匹配模型免训练采样加速的质量指标。

paragraphs.en: We find that representative training-free step-shortening methods often remain nearly lossless under FID/CLIP-class metrics, yet can suffer substantial quality degradation when evaluated with semantic-composition, dense-instruction, and long-text-rendering benchmarks such as GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench. Parallel sampling is a notable exception: by retaining the full-step discretization and removing only the solver’s temporal dependency, it can preserve near-lossless quality while accelerating sampling. Building on this observation, we propose ParaLin++ , a step-parity parallel sampler that preserves the full-step discretization while accelerating the solver iterations. Experiments across Stable Diffusion-v2, LSUN Church, FLUX.1-dev, and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 show that ParaLin++ preserves the full-step Euler quality profile at 2.6 × 2.6\times – 4.8 × 4.8\times , 1.68 × 1.68\times on FLUX, and 1.21 × 1.21\times on Ming. Project page: https://paralinplus.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，代表性的免训练步数缩减方法在 FID/CLIP 类指标下通常几乎无损，但在使用 GenEval、DPG-Bench 和 LongTextBench 等语义组合、密集指令与长文本渲染基准评估时，可能出现显著的质量下降。 并行采样是一个显著的例外：它通过保留完整步长离散化、仅去除求解器的时间依赖性，能够在加速采样的同时保持近乎无损的质量。 基于这一观察，我们提出 ParaLin++，一种步数对等的并行采样器，在加速求解器迭代的同时保留完整步长离散化。 在 Stable Diffusion-v2、LSUN Church、FLUX.1-dev 和 Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 上的实验表明，ParaLin++ 在 2.6 × 2.6\times – 4.8 × 4.8\times 的加速下保持了完整步长 Euler 的质量水平，在 FLUX 上达到 1.68 × 1.68\times，在 Ming 上达到 1.21 × 1.21\times。 项目主页：https://paralinplus.github.io/ 。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs) [ 22 , 60 ] are now widely used in image and video generation, including large flow-matching models such as FLUX [ 4 ] and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 [ 1 ] , with applications from high-fidelity synthesis [ 53 , 5 ] to molecular generation [ 68 , 50 ] and a broad range of generative tasks [ 69 , 39 , 43 , 9 , 44 , 70 , 37 ] . In practical use, sampling cost is a dominant inference bottleneck: each high-resolution sample requires a long sequence of neural function evaluations (NFEs), and the latency of this sequential trajectory constrains serving throughput, inference cost, and on-device feasibility.

paragraphs.en: The reference discretization of a DPM is a fixed N N -step ODE/SDE integrator, typically Euler with N = 30 N{=}30 steps for flow-matching models. Accelerating this pipeline has followed two structurally different routes, alongside a broader landscape of training-free speedups [ 16 , 75 , 17 , 13 , 39 , 47 ] . The first route shortens the discretization : high-order or few-step training-free solvers such as DDIM [ 57 ] , DPMSolver [ 42 , 41 ] , and UniPC [ 73 ] , together with distillation/consistency approaches [ 54 , 58 , 35 , 38 ] , cut the step count at the cost of changing the discretized trajectory. The second route removes solver latency instead : parallel sampling refines many time points concurrently, beginning with Picard iteration in ParaDiGMS [ 56 ] and progressing through triangular [ 62 ] and banded [ 45 ] nonlinear solvers, recently made NFE-efficient by the partial-linear formulation of ParaLin [ 46 ] . These two routes buy speed from different places: the first spends fewer integration steps , the second spends parallel compute to erase the solver’s temporal dependency .
paragraphs.zh: DPM 的参考离散化是一个固定的 N N 步 ODE/SDE 积分器，通常是流匹配模型采用 N = 30 N{=}30 步的欧拉法。 加速这一流程沿着两条结构上不同的路线发展，此外还有更广泛的免训练加速方法版图 [ 16 , 75 , 17 , 13 , 39 , 47 ] 。 第一条路线缩短离散化：高阶或少步数的免训练求解器，如 DDIM [ 57 ] 、DPMSolver [ 42 , 41 ] 和 UniPC [ 73 ] ，连同蒸馏/一致性方法 [ 54 , 58 , 35 , 38 ] ，以改变离散化轨迹为代价减少步数。 第二条路线则消除求解器延迟：并行采样同时细化多个时间点，从 ParaDiGMS [ 56 ] 中的 Picard 迭代开始，历经三角形 [ 62 ] 和带状 [ 45 ] 非线性求解器，最近通过 ParaLin [ 46 ] 的部分线性化形式实现了 NFE 高效。 这两条路线从不同的地方换取速度：第一条使用更少的积分步数，第二条投入并行计算以消除求解器的时间依赖性。

paragraphs.en: The decisive axis of a training-free accelerator is the metric that certifies it “quality-lossless,” not the speed lever it uses. Much of the literature uses distributional and coarse text-alignment proxies—FID measures closeness of the generated distribution to a reference, while CLIP measures coarse prompt–image embedding similarity. Post-trained text-to-image models, however, are often judged on a broader generation-quality profile: semantic composition (GenEval [ 15 ] ), dense instruction following (DPG-Bench [ 23 ] ), and long in-image text rendering (LongTextBench [ 14 ] ). A step-shortening strategy that looks lossless under FID can still alter the prompt-conditioned trajectory and produce a failed generation, because it changes the discrete trajectory on which prompt and text fidelity depend even when the marginal image distribution is preserved. We therefore focus on step-parity parallelization: keep the complete fixed-step system, but solve its coupled integration equations in parallel so that latency is removed without changing the discretization on which prompt-level and in-image text fidelity depend.
paragraphs.zh: 免训练加速器的决定性维度在于证明其“无损质量”的指标，而非它所使用的加速手段。 文献中大多使用分布层面和粗糙的文本对齐代理指标——FID 衡量生成分布与参考分布的接近程度，而 CLIP 衡量提示词与图像嵌入之间粗糙的相似性。 然而，后训练的文本到图像模型通常在更广泛的生成质量维度上被评估：语义组合（GenEval [ 15 ] ）、密集指令遵循（DPG-Bench [ 23 ] ）以及图像内长文本渲染（LongText-Bench [ 14 ] ）。 在 FID 下看似无损的缩短步数策略，仍可能改变由提示词条件化的轨迹并导致生成失败，因为它改变了提示词与文本保真度所依赖的离散轨迹，即使边缘图像分布得以保留。 因此，我们专注于步数对等的并行化：保持完整固定步数系统不变，但并行求解其耦合的积分方程，从而在不改变提示词级与图像内文本保真度所依赖的离散化的前提下消除时延。

paragraphs.en: 1 . A metric systemization and motivating finding. We systematize the quality metrics used to evaluate training-free sampling acceleration for diffusion and flow-matching models. Table I enumerates the evaluation protocols of a broad set of samplers—DDPM, DDIM, DPM-Solver, DPMSolver++, DPM-Solver-v3, UniPC, distillation and consistency methods, ParaDiGMS, ParaSolver, ParaLin, and ours—and shows that acceleration claims are usually certified by FID/CLIP-class metrics. These metrics measure statistical alignment or coarse prompt–image similarity; they do not directly measure semantic composition, dense instruction following, or in-image text rendering. Throughout, “complex generation quality” refers specifically to these three measurable axes rather than to an exhaustive definition of generation quality. Prior FID-oriented evaluations of DDIM, DPMSolver, DPMSolver++, and UniPC often report that few-step configurations remain close to the reference distribution [ 57 , 42 , 41 , 73 ] . Together with Table VI , this literature motivates a stricter audit: a 16-step DPMSolver++ configuration loses 21 % 21\% – 24 % 24\% GenEval, 6.5 6.5 – 8.2 8.2 DPG-Bench points, and 67 % 67\% – 70 % 70\% LongTextBench. Thus, the usual quality-lossless claim does not automatically transfer from FID/CLIP-style evidence to complex generation-quality benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: 2 . A stronger step-parity parallel solver, ParaLin++. We build the strongest available realization of the step-parity route to test how far this route reaches. Starting from ParaLin’s ϱ \varrho -nonlinear partial-linear system, we add an adaptive nonlinearization iteration, a successive-over-relaxation (SOR) update for both nonlinear and linear blocks, a sliding window, and an adaptive stopping rule based on relative historical errors and an exponential moving average. We prove that the SOR update is stable for 0 < ω < 2 / ( 1 + L ) 0<\omega<2/(1+L) (contraction factor L < 1 L<1 ) and that the system admits the sequential trajectory as its unique convergent root.

paragraphs.en: Implications of our study. Representative training-free step-shortening methods can appear nearly lossless under FID/CLIP yet show substantial degradation on more realistic and complex quality benchmarks. This argues for reporting generation-quality results alongside FID and for treating step-parity parallel sampling as an exception that can preserve near-lossless quality while accelerating sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究的启示。 有代表性的免训练步数缩短方法在 FID/CLIP 指标下可能看起来几乎无损，但在更真实、更复杂的质量基准上却表现出明显的性能下降。 这表明在报告生成质量结果时应同时报告 FID，并将步数对等的并行采样视为一种例外——它能够在加速采样的同时保持近乎无损的质量。

paragraphs.en: Step-parity temporal parallelization. Parallel sampling removes the temporal dependency of a fixed-step diffusion integrator by refining multiple time states concurrently. ParaDiGMS [ 56 ] introduced this direction through Picard–Lindelöf fixed-point iteration; Self-Refining Diffusion Samplers [ 55 ] use Parareal iterations; ParaTAA [ 62 ] formulates a triangular nonlinear system; and ParaSolver [ 45 ] improves efficiency through banded and hierarchical parallelization. CHORDS [ 19 ] further treats multi-core sampling as a hierarchy of increasingly accurate solvers, whereas ParaAnya [ 71 ] uses a plug-and-play output cache to avoid repeated evaluations at overlapping timesteps. These methods reinforce the same trade-off as ParaDiGMS: additional parallel compute replaces sequential time, rather than coarsening the integration grid. ParaLin [ 46 ] reduces the NFE overhead of fully nonlinear iterations by exploiting partial linearity; ParaLin++ strengthens this solver with adaptive nonlinearization, over-relaxation, and adaptive stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 步数对齐的时间并行化。 并行采样通过同时细化多个时间状态，消除了固定步长扩散积分器的时间依赖性。 ParaDiGMS [ 56 ] 通过 Picard–Lindelöf 不动点迭代开创了这一方向；自精炼扩散采样器 [ 55 ] 使用 Parareal 迭代；ParaTAA [ 62 ] 将其表述为三角非线性系统；ParaSolver [ 45 ] 通过带状与分层并行化提升效率。 CHORDS [ 19 ] 进一步将多核采样视为精度递增的求解器层级结构，而 ParaAnya [ 71 ] 使用即插即用的输出缓存来避免在重叠时间步上的重复计算。 这些方法强化了与 ParaDiGMS 相同的权衡：用额外的并行算力替代串行时间，而非粗化积分网格。 ParaLin [ 46 ] 通过利用部分线性性降低了完全非线性迭代的 NFE 开销；ParaLin++ 通过自适应非线性化、超松弛和自适应停止来强化该求解器。

sents.en: Step-parity temporal parallelization.
sents.zh: 步数对齐的时间并行化。

sents.en: Parallel sampling removes the temporal dependency of a fixed-step diffusion integrator by refining multiple time states concurrently.
sents.zh: 并行采样通过同时细化多个时间状态，消除了固定步长扩散积分器的时间依赖性。

sents.en: ParaDiGMS [ 56 ] introduced this direction through Picard–Lindelöf fixed-point iteration; Self-Refining Diffusion Samplers [ 55 ] use Parareal iterations; ParaTAA [ 62 ] formulates a triangular nonlinear system; and ParaSolver [ 45 ] improves efficiency through banded and hierarchical parallelization.
sents.zh: ParaDiGMS [ 56 ] 通过 Picard–Lindelöf 不动点迭代开创了这一方向；自精炼扩散采样器 [ 55 ] 使用 Parareal 迭代；ParaTAA [ 62 ] 将其表述为三角非线性系统；ParaSolver [ 45 ] 通过带状与分层并行化提升效率。

sents.en: CHORDS [ 19 ] further treats multi-core sampling as a hierarchy of increasingly accurate solvers, whereas ParaAnya [ 71 ] uses a plug-and-play output cache to avoid repeated evaluations at overlapping timesteps.
sents.zh: CHORDS [ 19 ] 进一步将多核采样视为精度递增的求解器层级结构，而 ParaAnya [ 71 ] 使用即插即用的输出缓存来避免在重叠时间步上的重复计算。

sents.en: These methods reinforce the same trade-off as ParaDiGMS: additional parallel compute replaces sequential time, rather than coarsening the integration grid.
sents.zh: 这些方法强化了与 ParaDiGMS 相同的权衡：用额外的并行算力替代串行时间，而非粗化积分网格。

sents.en: ParaLin [ 46 ] reduces the NFE overhead of fully nonlinear iterations by exploiting partial linearity; ParaLin++ strengthens this solver with adaptive nonlinearization, over-relaxation, and adaptive stopping.
sents.zh: ParaLin [ 46 ] 通过利用部分线性性降低了完全非线性迭代的 NFE 开销；ParaLin++ 通过自适应非线性化、超松弛和自适应停止来强化该求解器。

paragraphs.en: A closely related but distinct solver is EPD [ 78 ] , which evaluates multiple gradient directions concurrently inside each ODE step and learns a small set of solver parameters through distillation. Unlike step-parity methods, it changes the local integration rule and requires a lightweight training stage. Recent theory also cautions against an unconstrained parallelization story: parallel-round lower bounds [ 31 ] show that some distributions necessarily retain polynomial sequential dependence. ParaLin++ is therefore formulated as a practical fixed-step parallel integrator, not as a claim that all diffusion sampling can be made depth-free.
paragraphs.zh: 一种密切相关但不同的求解器是 EPD [ 78 ]，它在每个 ODE 步内并发评估多个梯度方向，并通过蒸馏学习一小组求解器参数。 与步数对齐方法不同，它改变了局部积分规则，并且需要一个轻量级的训练阶段。 近期理论也对无约束并行化的叙事提出了警示：并行轮数下界 [ 31 ] 表明，某些分布必然保留多项式级的串行依赖。 因此，ParaLin++ 被构建为一个实用的固定步数并行积分器，而非声称所有扩散采样都可以做到与深度无关。

paragraphs.en: Speculative and asynchronous parallelism. A second parallel family drafts approximate future states and verifies or refines them in parallel. Diffusion speculative sampling [ 11 ] preserves the target distribution by accepting or correcting draft proposals; FREE [ 67 ] extends this idea to feature-level autoregression in DiTs; SpecDiff [ 51 ] combines self-speculation with feature caching; and DRiffusion [ 3 ] uses a draft-and-refine process. AsyncDiff [ 8 ] instead breaks component dependencies through asynchronous denoising. These methods exploit drafts, verifiers, or stale hidden states, and thus change the execution graph; ParaLin++ solves the coupled fixed-step integration system directly and does not introduce an auxiliary drafter.

These methods are relevant baselines for the quality audit, but they still alter the discretization on which prompt-conditioned trajectories depend.

paragraphs.en: Per-step compute reduction and model parallelism. Orthogonal accelerators reduce the cost of each denoising evaluation. They include feature and block caching [ 49 , 48 , 40 ] , DiT attention or token sparsification [ 74 , 26 ] , temporal feature forecasting [ 36 , 18 ] , path-planned cache scheduling [ 10 ] , and distributed or asynchronous execution [ 33 , 66 , 8 ] . Guidance acceleration [ 65 ] , trajectory stitching [ 52 ] , nested diffusion [ 12 ] , and minimum-step prediction [ 72 ] are likewise complementary. These systems change the executed network path or decide when a cheaper computation is acceptable; ParaLin++ changes neither the timestep grid nor the full-step denoiser evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 每步计算量削减与模型并行。 正交的加速方法可降低每次去噪求值的成本。 它们包括特征与块缓存 [ 49 , 48 , 40 ] 、DiT 注意力或词元稀疏化 [ 74 , 26 ] 、时序特征预测 [ 36 , 18 ] 、路径规划的缓存调度 [ 10 ] ，以及分布式或异步执行 [ 33 , 66 , 8 ] 。 引导加速 [ 65 ] 、轨迹拼接 [ 52 ] 、嵌套扩散 [ 12 ] 与最少步数预测 [ 72 ] 同样是互补的。 这些系统会改变实际执行的网络路径，或判断何时可以接受更廉价的计算；ParaLin++ 既不改变时间步网格，也不改变完整步骤的去噪器求值。

paragraphs.en: Quality-focused evaluation. The claim that FID/CLIP evidence is insufficient is consistent with the evaluation literature: TIFA uses visual question answering to test fine-grained prompt faithfulness [ 24 ] ; VQAScore and GenAI-Bench target compositional prompts [ 34 ] ; and T2I-CompBench++ evaluates attributes, relations, and numeracy [ 25 ] . GenEval 2 additionally warns that static benchmarks can drift as generation models improve [ 28 ] . Our audit therefore interprets GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench as a fixed, reproducible quality profile rather than as an absolute or exhaustive definition of generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 以质量为中心的评估。 关于 FID/CLIP 证据不足的说法与评估文献一致：TIFA 使用视觉问答来测试细粒度的提示词忠实度 [ 24 ] ；VQAScore 和 GenAI-Bench 针对组合式提示词 [ 34 ] ；而 T2I-CompBench++ 则评估属性、关系和数值能力 [ 25 ] 。 GenEval 2 还警告，随着生成模型不断改进，静态基准测试可能会出现漂移 [ 28 ] 。 因此，我们的审计将 GenEval、DPG-Bench 和 LongTextBench 解读为一个固定的、可复现的质量画像，而非对生成质量的绝对或穷尽式定义。

paragraphs.en: We systematize training-free diffusion acceleration through the quality metrics on which its “quality-lossless” claims rest, rather than through the speed lever it uses, because FID/CLIP-style evidence does not by itself establish preservation on complex prompts. We first enumerate the evaluation protocols of the academic acceleration literature (Table I ) and identify what these methods actually measure; we then test representative few-step quality claims under a generation-quality audit and find substantial degradation (Section V , summarized in Table VI ).

paragraphs.en: Table I surveys the quality metrics used to evaluate a broad set of training-free samplers and their close relatives, from DDPM and DDIM through high-order solvers (DPM-Solver, DPMSolver++, DPM-Solver-v3, UniPC) and distillation/consistency methods, to parallel samplers (ParaDiGMS, ParaTAA, ParaSolver, ParaLin) and our ParaLin++. Two patterns are immediate. First , nearly every method is evaluated with distributional and text-alignment metrics only: FID (and its variants sFID, clean-FID) measures closeness of the generated distribution to a reference distribution, while CLIP score/CLIP-FID measures coarse prompt–image embedding similarity, and a handful additionally report Inception-based diversity (IS, Precision–Recall). These quantify statistical alignment —whether the marginal image distribution or the prompt–image embedding stays close to a reference—not whether a specific generated sample succeeds at semantic composition, dense instruction following, or long-text rendering. Second , few methods explicitly audit these generation-quality dimensions. Recent large-scale models such as FLUX [ 4 ] and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 [ 1 ] , in contrast, report GenEval-, DPG-Bench-, and LongTextBench-style numbers, whereas FID/CLIP are scarce or absent in their evaluation reports. A sampler certified only by FID/CLIP-style metrics can therefore appear lossless while remaining fragile on complex prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 表I综述了用于评估一大批免训练采样器及其近亲方法的 качества量指标，涵盖从DDPM和DDIM到高阶求解器（DPM-Solver、DPMSolver++、DPM-Solver-v3、UniPC）以及蒸馏/一致性方法，再到并行采样器（ParaDiGMS、ParaTAA、ParaSolver、ParaLin）和我们的ParaLin++。 可以立即看出两个规律。 第一，几乎所有方法都仅使用分布指标和文本对齐指标进行评估：FID（及其变体sFID、clean-FID）衡量生成分布与参考分布的接近程度，而CLIP分数/CLIP-FID衡量提示词—图像嵌入的粗粒度相似性，少数方法还报告基于Inception的多样性指标（IS、Precision–Recall）。 这些指标衡量的是统计对齐——即边缘图像分布或提示词—图像嵌入是否接近参考分布——而不是某个具体生成样本能否成功完成语义组合、密集指令遵循或长文本渲染。 第二，很少有方法显式审计这些生成质量维度。 相比之下，近期的大规模模型如FLUX [4]和Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 [1]报告的是GenEval、DPG-Bench和LongTextBench风格的数值，而FID/CLIP在其评估报告中则很少出现或完全缺失。 因此，仅通过FID/CLIP类指标认证的采样器可能在复杂提示词上仍然脆弱，却显得无损。

paragraphs.en: The metrics gap is not cosmetic. We further test the same training-free accelerators under the generation-quality profile—GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench—on the high-capacity FLUX.1-dev [ 4 ] , against the same-CFG 30-step Euler reference; the result is summarized in Table VI and elaborated in Section V . Methods advertised as nearly quality-lossless under FID show substantial degradation on the generation-quality metrics. Prior FID-oriented evaluations support the general expectation that reduced-step configurations can remain close to the reference distribution [ 57 , 42 , 41 , 73 ] ; in our audit, however, 16-step UniPC and DPMSolver++ cause GenEval to fall from 0.66 0.66 to 0.50 0.50 – 0.52 0.52 , DPG-Bench from 83.97 83.97 to 75.75 75.75 – 77.46 77.46 , and LongTextBench from 0.27 0.27 to 0.08 0.08 – 0.09 0.09 . An image distribution can stay FID-plausible while the model omits requested objects, breaks spatial relations, or renders unreadable text. paragraphs.en: This failure is structural rather than incidental. paragraphs.en: Prior works [ 56 , 62 , 45 ] typically employ a single tolerance, denoted as δ \delta , to control the state difference across all timesteps. However, we find that this coarse-grained method cannot accurately identify states that have already converged, leading to superfluous iteration steps to update them. paragraphs.en: Latent-space Speedup Comparison . Table III shows the experimental results on DDIM, DPMSolver, and their parallel variants when combined with ParaSolver, ParaDiGMS, ParaLin, and our ParaLin++, respectively. ParaLin++ demonstrates significant acceleration for DDIM and DPMSolver while maintaining comparable FID and CLIP scores. Notably, it achieves a remarkable wall-clock time speedup of up to 4.8 × 4.8\times , setting a new benchmark for parallel diffusion methods. Although parallelization inherently trades computational efficiency for speed, leading to increased NFEs relative to sequential approaches, our method capitalizes on partial linearity to substantially reduce NFEs, thereby unleashing the parallel efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Pixel-space Speedup Comparison . Similarly, Table IV shows that ParaLin++ consistently surpasses existing methods, delivering wall-clock speedups of 3.1 × 3.1\times – 4.5 × 4.5\times on the LSUN Church model across the tested step configurations. paragraphs.en: Prior FID-oriented evaluations of DDIM, DPMSolver, DPMSolver++, and UniPC support the common expectation that few-step solvers can preserve distributional statistics [ 57 , 42 , 41 , 73 ] . Table VI therefore asks whether this expectation transfers to GenEval, DPG-Bench, and LongTextBench for the same FLUX solvers. UniPC and DPMSolver++ with 16 discrete steps lose 21 % 21\% – 24 % 24\% relative GenEval score, 6.5 6.5 – 8.2 8.2 DPG-Bench points, and 67 % 67\% – 70 % 70\% of the LongTextBench score. ParaLin++ instead keeps all 30 discrete diffusion steps and parallelizes the iterative solve: it closely preserves the Euler-level generation-quality profile ( 0.64 0.64 versus 0.66 0.66 GenEval, 84.24 84.24 versus 83.97 83.97 DPG-Bench, and 0.26 0.26 versus 0.27 0.27 LongTextBench) and achieves a 1.68 × 1.68\times GenEval-forward speedup. Hence, the acceleration is obtained by removing latency in the solver iteration rather than by shortening the diffusion discretization on which prompt-level and in-image text fidelity depends.
paragraphs.zh: 此前针对 DDIM、DPMSolver、DPMSolver++ 和 UniPC 的以 FID 为导向的评估支持一种普遍预期，即少步求解器能够保持分布统计特性 [ 57 , 42 , 41 , 73 ] 。 因此，表 VI 探讨了这一预期对于相同 FLUX 求解器在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 和 LongTextBench 上是否同样成立。 采用 16 个离散步骤的 UniPC 和 DPMSolver++ 损失了 21 % 21\% – 24 % 24\% 的相对 GenEval 得分、6.5 6.5 – 8.2 8.2 个 DPG-Bench 点数，以及 67 % 67\% – 70 % 70\% 的 LongTextBench 得分。 ParaLin++ 则保留全部 30 个离散扩散步骤并对迭代求解进行并行化：它几乎完整地保持了 Euler 水平的生成质量表现（GenEval 为 0.64 0.64 对 0.66 0.66，DPG-Bench 为 84.24 84.24 对 83.97 83.97，LongTextBench 为 0.26 0.26 对 0.27 0.27），并实现了 1.68 × 1.68\times 的 GenEval 前向加速。 因此，该加速是通过消除求解器迭代中的延迟获得的，而不是通过缩短提示级与图内文本保真度所依赖的扩散离散化来实现的。

paragraphs.en: This evaluation protocol also reflects the objectives of recent large-scale generators. Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 [ 1 ] , the sparse unified successor to Ming-Omni [ 2 ] , reports 0.94 0.94 GenEval and 86.98 86.98 DPG-Bench, and its post-training explicitly optimizes realism, instruction adherence, and aesthetic quality together with task-specific rewards. These are generation-quality axes that FID does not reliably capture. Accordingly, the FLUX study and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 reference establish a more realistic quality test bed for judging whether a fast diffusion sampler merely matches a distributional statistic or actually preserves generation quality. In addition to the motivating 16-step comparison, Table VII records the complete 16-, 20-, 24-, 26-, and 30-step generation-quality benchmark matrices for FLUX and Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0. The table separates the number of discrete diffusion steps from the number of solver iterations: sequential samplers use one iteration per step, whereas ParaLin++ keeps 30 discrete steps and reports its average number of parallel solver iterations separately. paragraphs.en: Single GPU for Acceleration Parallel sampling methods are often criticized for trading excessive computational cost for speed, which is impractical for users with limited resources. However, our experiments in Table IX demonstrate the real-world viability of our approach on a single GPU. Unlike competing parallel methods like ParaDiGMS, which often fail to provide any speedup or even decelerate the process in this setting, our ParaLin++ achieves consistent and significant wall-clock acceleration across all baseline samplers. For instance, it speeds up the 100-step DDIM by 4.2 × 4.2\times and the 100-step DPMSolver by 3.7 × 3.7\times . This is accomplished while maintaining virtually identical generation quality (FID and CLIP scores). This validates ParaLin++ as a practical and potent accelerator for everyday users, effectively overcoming the typical computational barriers of parallel sampling even in resource-constrained, single-GPU environments.
paragraphs.zh: 单GPU加速 并行采样方法常因以过高的计算成本换取速度而受到批评，这对资源有限的用户来说并不实际。 然而，我们在表IX中的实验证明了我们的方法在单个GPU上的现实可行性。 与ParaDiGMS等竞争性并行方法不同——它们在此设置下往往无法提供任何加速，甚至会减慢生成过程——我们的ParaLin++在所有基线采样器上均实现了一致且显著的实际耗时加速。 例如，它将100步DDIM提速4.2 × 4.2\times倍，将100步DPMSolver提速3.7 × 3.7\times倍。 与此同时，生成质量（FID和CLIP分数）几乎保持完全一致。 这验证了ParaLin++是面向普通用户的实用且强大的加速器，有效克服了并行采样常见的计算障碍，即使在资源受限的单GPU环境中亦然。

Full nonlinearity reduces iterations but multiplies NFEs and becomes slower than the sequential baseline. Partial nonlinearity removes 93.3 % 93.3\% of these NFEs relative to the fully nonlinear variant and already restores wall-clock speedup. paragraphs.en: Generalization on VP, VE, and EDM Process. We investigated the impact of the VP, VE, and EDM diffusion processes by converting the sequential sampler in Alg. 1 of work [ 29 ] into our parallel version. Adopting the Tab. 1 configurations specified in work [ 29 ] , we then analyzed the effect of the nonlinear degree ϱ \varrho on FID performance across these three processes using the provided ImageNet dataset. As shown in Tab. XI , our parallel sampling method demonstrates its applicability and effectiveness across all three diffusion processes. For each process, our parallel approach consistently reduces the number of sampling iterations while achieving comparable or improved FID scores compared to the sequential baseline. This highlights the robustness and efficiency of our method, making it a viable accelerator for various diffusion model formulations. We notice that our method yields a better FID score for every schedule and a substantially larger gain in the VP process. This improvement likely stems from the inherently stiff nature of the VP-ODE, combined with the step-parallel updates of our parallel solver. The step-parallel updates sever the temporal dependence chain across steps, thus effectively curtail the accumulation of truncation error across steps [ 29 ] . As a result, our solver acts as an implicit numerical stabilizer for the stiff VP-ODE, which typically exhibits significant truncation error that degrades the performance of conventional VP samplers.

paragraphs.en: EMA Decay Rate β \beta and Tolerance δ \delta Analysis. As shown in Table XIII , the EMA decay rate ( β \beta ) is critical for sample quality. A low value ( β = 0.9 \beta=0.9 ) causes noticeable FID degradation, whereas higher values ( β ≥ 0.99 \beta\geq 0.99 ) consistently achieve FIDs comparable to or better than the baseline. paragraphs.en: We systematized training-free diffusion acceleration by the metrics that certify its quality-preservation claims, exposing heavy reliance on FID/CLIP-style evidence. Our generation-quality audit shows that representative few-step solvers can remain FID-close yet lose substantial semantic-composition, instruction-following, and long-text-rendering quality. To accelerate without shortening the trajectory, ParaLin++ strengthens ParaLin’s partial-linear solver with adaptive nonlinearization, successive over-relaxation, sliding windows, and adaptive stopping, supported by stability and uniqueness guarantees. It preserves the full-step quality profile while reaching 1.68 × 1.68\times on FLUX.1-dev, 1.21 × 1.21\times on Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0, and 2.6 × 2.6\times – 4.8 × 4.8\times on Stable Diffusion-v2/LSUN Church. Acceleration claims should therefore report generation-quality metrics alongside FID/CLIP and separate discrete steps from solver iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕那些用于验证免训练扩散加速质量保持声明的指标，对这一领域进行了系统化梳理，揭示了现有方法对 FID/CLIP 类证据的严重依赖。 我们的质量审计表明，具有代表性的少步求解器即便 FID 表现接近，仍可能在语义组合、指令遵循和长文本渲染方面出现大幅质量损失。 为了在不缩短轨迹的前提下实现加速，ParaLin++ 在 ParaLin 的部分线性求解器基础上增强了自适应非线性化、逐次超松弛、滑动窗口和自适应停止机制，并有稳定性与唯一性保证作为支撑。 它在保持完整步数质量水平的同时，在 FLUX.1-dev 上达到 1.68 × 1.68\times，在 Ming-Flash-Omni 2.0 上达到 1.21 × 1.21\times，在 Stable Diffusion-v2/LSUN Church 上达到 2.6 × 2.6\times – 4.8 × 4.8\times。 因此，加速声明应在报告 FID/CLIP 指标的同时一并报告生成质量指标，并将离散步数与求解器迭代次数区分开来。
